description: This Java class 'GccMapReader' is a utility for parsing and printing information from GCC linked .map files, extracting memory segment data and calculating total sizes.

classes.name: GccMapReader
classes.description: Main class providing static methods to parse GCC map files and output memory segment information.

classes.name: Record
classes.description: Inner class representing a memory record with size and name, comparable by size and name.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that reads a file, processes its lines, sorts records, and outputs total size.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Parses lines to extract memory records related to '.bss.' segments.

methods.name: parseMultiLine
methods.description: Handles multi-line record parsing, extracting size and name.

methods.name: parseSingleLine
methods.description: Handles single-line record parsing, extracting size and name.
